featured_reviews.name: Shradha Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text:
Here's a review for D-Mart near Kanjurmarg Station:

---

This D-Mart near Kanjurmarg station is super convenient, especially for everyday shopping. It’s a two-storey setup, with groceries and daily essentials on the ground floor. You can find everything you need, from fresh produce to packaged goods, at affordable prices.

The upper floor is dedicated to clothing for men, women, and children, along with home essentials like utensils and décor items. It's a great one-stop shop for your household needs.

After you’re done shopping, there’s a small D-Mart outlet right at the exit that offers ice cream and popcorn, which is a nice touch, especially if you're shopping with kids. Overall, it's a well-organized and budget-friendly store!

featured_reviews.name: Vikas Mahadik
featured_reviews.review_text: Too crowded place. No Parking facility. You will never find wall clock inside the mart where people lost themselves in endless shopping for no reason & finally realize paying higher bills once they return home. Staffs are too busy to address your requirements. Buy 1 Get 1 is an easy way to trap the customer. Sometime you finish shopping in 5 minutes but have to wait in Q for billing more than 20 minutes. Total waste of time, money and energy.

featured_reviews.name: Rudra Verma
featured_reviews.review_text:
DMart Kanjurmarg is  located within walking distance from Kanjurmarg railway station. The store is well organized with separate sections for different categories of products. It has two floors the ground floor mainly offers groceries, food items, and daily essentials, while the first floor has clothing and footwear for men and women, kitchen utensils, travel bags, kid's toys, and other household items.

Most products are available at lower prices compared to local retailers, making it a good option for regular shopping. Both cash and digital payments are accepted, and the return policy is clearly mentioned and easy to follow.

The staff members are polite, helpful, and cooperative, which makes the overall shopping experience pleasant. Overall, DMart Kanjurmarg is a convenient and budget-friendly place to shop for daily needs.

featured_reviews.review_text: Discover the ultimate wholesale shopping experience at the Eastern Business District in Bhandup! It is the perfect venue to stock up on groceries and household essentials at discounted rates. A promising spot for every shopper.

featured_reviews.name: Kajal Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Metro at Neptune Mall is a large store with a wide variety of products, from groceries to electronics. It’s spacious and well-stocked, making shopping easy. Prices are reasonable, and everything is under one roof. However, the cash staff is rude, and they should open more billing counters during peak hours to avoid long waits. A good store, but checkout needs improvement.

featured_reviews.name: Naveen Suvarna
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst hygiene level. Everyone touching the fish, chicken and meat without washing hands. Serval complaints made to Supervisor Irfan
no action taken.FDA should ban this outlet from selling meat and fish.

featured_reviews.name: Vedant Chaudhari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Its a big shop for all business customers and not meant for retail customers. Very spacious and variety of goods. Mostly good discounts on cloth and electronic items like TV, Fridge, Washing machine, Ac there are great price discount in this products. There are also great discounts on clothing mostly there are men's clothing options. There is also trial rooms to try the cloths. You get more discount if buy the products in bulk.
Tip you need the should be a metro card holder for shopping in metro.

featured_reviews.name: Ronen Wasker
featured_reviews.review_text:
A great place to shop at wholesale rates that too all type of items under 1 roof. Always with discounts and great offers. Name the item and it will be there, that's the best part of this mall. They do have delivery options if u end up buying toooo much, and yes it tends to happen once u start shopping.
Point to remember - one has to have metro cash and carry membership card to enter the mall and shop. It is only provided to people who have active business (shop owners).

review_photos.caption: Fruits and vegetables section along with dairy section
Also has a separate meat and fish section which does not spread odour in the mall.. Plus point..

featured_reviews.name: Imran Pathan
featured_reviews.review_text: I did use the card over here to pay for my shopping. It was a good experience, lot of options. Lovely place. Spacious, good collection and discount. It is more for people who are wholesaler, rather than for those who are looking for few things that will carry on for a week or so. You need to make an I'd to enter this place. Nicely maintained and clean.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Unko address and location yaad dilana padta hai....ek dusre ke uppar dalte baithte hai.

so many negative reviews this days for odeon Shivraj

featured_reviews.name: Mitesh Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good super market wide wide variety of food items, clothes, home needs are all available on single roof. Some items have good discount at times. Accepts Sodexo meal pass at MRP rates.
Accepts debit  / credit card as well as UPI apart from cash.

featured_reviews.name: INDER PAREKH
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I BOUGHT LIFEBUOY HANDWASH BILLED @195 EACH WHICH WAS 1+1FREE
WHEN I TOLD THEY REFUND ONLY RS. 92 SAYING IF YOU WANT FREE THAN YOU HAVE TO PAY AS PER MRP NOT UNDERSTAND THE ACCOUNTING SYSTEM IF YOU ARE BILLING 195 IT'S COMPANY'S SCHEME TO GIVE FREE AS PER MENTIONED ON PRODUCT.
SAME  INCIDENT ON OTHER PRODUCT ALSO DONE LAST WEEK BUT I DIDN'T TOOK SIRIOUSLY BUT TODAY AGAIN HAPPEN.
SO REALLY Disappointed ITS NOT QUESTION ABOUT RS. 4 OR 5. BUT QUESTION ON HONESTY..
AND OF COURSE Behaviour OF ACCOUNTING PERSONS ALSO NOT GOOD IN BOTH TIME.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear INDER PAREKH,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused during your recent purchase. We truly value your feedback and understand your concern regarding the billing of the Lifebuoy Handwash offer. We will look into the issue with our billing team to ensure such confusion does not happen again.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention, and we’re sorry for the experience you had.

featured_reviews.name: Purna Jabi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good place.
Good food collection
Nice staff
But if the staff can work at one side without obstruction of the path and talk softly that would be appreciated.
They tend to hinder the path often by coming in the way or by keeping stools, tables, and such things in the way. This makes shopping difficult for us.

thank you sir for your reply and you commends and suggestion
we appreciate your feedback and try to work on it

featured_reviews.name: Ms Bhat
featured_reviews.review_text:
A relatively smaller when compared with malls in space.but has everything that one thinks of. Many things that are introduced in the market one gets here at good discounts as far as food stuffs are concerned.
A never to miss visit place whenever one has time.
No. Of varieties have increased. Particularly with offers in coffee powder section. Hope the trend will continue.
Like the one which everyone saw in milk some two years back. The prices of milk sachets were a record low never seen in the past at that point of time.
Yes this is the change.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for your detailed feedback Ms Bhat! 
We’re glad you enjoy shopping with us and appreciate your support.

featured_reviews.name: jyoti das
featured_reviews.review_text:
While shopping in this dept. Shop u can expect the unexpected.
They make the bill over priced sometimes for 5k bill they make a bill of 8k. Thank God we check each and every item to realise it's over charged. After bringing it to their notice they were reluctant and then they corrected it. Today also same thing happened.We opted for home delivery and 1 item missing in it. We know it's a case with this shopping store so we check each and every item with the bill. God knows if we will b given our missed item or not.
Rediculous and disgusting way to cheat people.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We’re very sorry to hear about your experience jyoti das. This should not have happened. We will check the issue and make sure it is solved. Thank you for bringing it to our notice.
